selectionRule: Exact versions were selected from the stable release entries listed by PyPI's per-project release feed at check time (newest stable entry), except pdfminer.six, which the direct record pins at ==20260107. A selected version was accepted only when its exact-version metadata declared a wheel whose tag is compatible with CPython 3.14 on Linux x86_64. This is a bounded metadata selection, not a latestness, minimality, resolver-execution, compatibility, or approval claim.

directCandidateSource.note: The nine direct nodes, their declared fields and their selected direct artifacts are reused from this accepted parent record. They were not reacquired and remain metadata declarations only.

environmentMarkers.method: Every requirement string present in the saved projections has exactly one edge (49/49). Marker strings are quoted exactly as declared. Version floors were checked by direct numeric comparison of the selected version, not by a full PEP 440/508 resolver.
environmentMarkers.limitations: The nine direct nodes carry only the parent record's baseRequiresDist and extras names; extra requirement strings for those distributions were not saved in that record and are not claimed covered here. Transitive nodes (including Pillow 13.0.0) carry their full requires_dist, so all 26 Pillow extra-only strings have explicit excluded edges.

sourceAcquisition.source: Official PyPI exact-version JSON endpoints plus small per-project PyPI release feeds for version discovery
sourceAcquisition.transport: Python standard-library HTTPS with default certificate verification and redirect refusal. Each 64KiB body chunk was received and then counted against the caps before any JSON/XML parsing; Content-Length was checked before the body when present.

acquisitionEnforcement.correction: An earlier version of this record and its report described the caps as enforced before reads and the aggregate as one shared budget. That description was inaccurate. This revision records the observed implementation and its limits instead of erasing the earlier claim; no reacquisition was performed.
acquisitionEnforcement.implementationObserved: In fetch_bounded.py, a present Content-Length was checked before reading, but the body loop called resp.read(65536) and only after each returned chunk added it to the per-invocation counters and compared them with the caps. One chunk could therefore be received before an over-cap result was raised.
acquisitionEnforcement.counterScope: Each of five invocations (discovery, discovery2, exact, exact2, exact3) ran in a new process with aggregate and version-request counters starting at zero.
acquisitionEnforcement.aggregateTotalBasis: After-the-fact sum of the 24 saved per-response receipt byte counts, not a value enforced by a single shared counter.
acquisitionEnforcement.rawBodyIntegrityProof: Not available. The saved discovery*.json and exact*.json files are projections built after parsing; their recorded SHA256 values are claims computed by the fetch script over raw bodies that were not retained. They cannot be independently reverified from the saved projections alone.
